run_image_variation_pipeline: run the StableDiffusionImageVariationPipeline to generate image variations from an input PIL image using from_pretrained
encode_image_with_clip: encode an input image into CLIP image embeddings using the _encode_image method for classifier-free guidance
prepare_latents_for_diffusion: prepare random Gaussian latents scaled by init_noise_sigma using the prepare_latents method for a given batch size and shape
run_safety_checker_on_images: run the safety checker on generated images to detect NSFW content using the run_safety_checker method
decode_latents_to_images: decode VAE latents into pixel-space images using the vae.decode method and postprocess with VaeImageProcessor
